notes: BUU v3.0.6 - update check fixed (plus all of 3.0.5). The 'read ECONNRESET' failure is solved: the firewall resets the first connection after opening BUU (why the update bar only appeared on second open) - checks and downloads now retry automatically. Includes 3.0.5's data safety: the uninstaller NEVER deletes flows/logs/failures/schedules on any path (parked to C:\BUU-preserved, restored automatically) and the updater backs up flows+schedules before any install; checks time out in 15s with a clear reason; start mode saves with each flow (Run all = unattended every time, incl. schedules; older flows load as Run all); the schedules picker explains itself when empty.
